svg.title: 04 · Analyzer
svg.desc: The user's analyzer board: the frontend sends a question to the KPI gate, which answers with a preset query when one fits; otherwise the Claim Query Agent, fed by its example bank, cached references and prompts, writes CLI calls with SQL that pass the SQL guard to the DuckDB query service, which reads only this customer's semantic layer.

g.text: 16 presets, fixed SQL · the gate fills
payer, payer class, month, CPT, CARC
would it fail? stop it here
no keyless joins > 100 M row pairs

svg.text: FAILS A CHECK: ERROR TO THE AGENT
The Claim Query Agent is the run worker. The DuckDB query service holds the credentials.
GATE 6 · IAM + KMS: this customer only
AGENT WRITES CLI CALLS WITH SQL
PRESET SQL, PARAMETERS CHECKED AGAINST THE DATA
Claim Query Agent · the run worker on Fargate: the backend for ClaimClarity, and part of the backend for Agentic Next Best Actions
Core Principle: Enforce the semantic layer. This is a schema of curated tables that the agent can query to answer nearly every question.
We do this to save tokens, and make the agent write queries in a simple interface.
Curated tables built from silver by the parser at load time;
simple to understand and interact with
Every field from the raw EDI files, structured;
Opened only when the agent decides the curated
tables cannot fully answer the question
